You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which article of the Regulation corresponds to Article 12 of Directive 2006/42/EC?

Facts:
[0] Chapter VI of this Regulation (mutatis mutandis to such products) — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [condition: mutatis mutandis to such products instead of Article 11 of that Directive, including products for which a procedure has already been initiated under Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 7]
[1] Directive 2006/42/EC — repealedFrom — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5]
[2] products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC — placingAllowedUntil — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [condition: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 14 January 2027] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6]
[3] Articles 26 to 42 — appliesFrom — 20 January 2024 (2024-01-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 11]
[4] provisions necessary to comply with this Directive — appliesFrom — 29 December 2009 (2009-12-29) [DIR, Art. 26(1)]
[5] Regulation — appliesFrom — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [condition: However, the following Articles shall apply from the following dates] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10]
[6] Article 6(7) and Articles 48 and 52 — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 13]
[7] This Directive — appliesFrom — 20th day following its publication (20th day following its publication) [DIR, Art. 28]
[8] Article 6(2) to (6), (8) and (11) and Articles 47 and 53(3) — appliesFrom — 20 July 2024 (2024-07-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 14]
[9] categories of machinery listed in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — one of the procedures referred to in Article 12(3) and (4) (one of the procedures referred to in article 12(3) and (4)) [DIR, Annex IV]
[10] categories of machinery or related products — requiresProcedure — procedure referred to in Article 25(2) (procedure referred to in article 25(2)) [REG, Annex I, Part A]
[11] categories of machinery in Annex I Part B — requiresProcedure — one of the procedures referred to in Article 25(3) (one of the procedures referred to in article 25(3)) [REG, Annex I, Part B]
[12] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — the information referred to in Article 10(7) (the information referred to in article 10(7)) [REG, Art. 13(4)]
[13] products within the scope of this Regulation — definedAs — machinery, the related products listed in the first subparagraph (machinery, the related products listed in the first subparagraph) [REG, Art. 2(1)]
[14] EC declaration of conformity — hasObligation — must be those of the texts published in the Official Journal of the European Union (must be those of the texts published in the Official Journal of the European Union) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[15] machinery referred to in Annex IV — requiresProcedure — EC type-examination procedure (ec type-examination procedure) [condition: provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[16] EU declaration of incorporation — hasObligation — shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned (shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned, including their publication references) [condition: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity] [REG, Art. 22(3)]
[17] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(3)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[18] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(2)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[19] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) (eu type-examination (module b)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[20] accreditation — definedAs — Article 2, point (10), of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 (article 2, point (10), of regulation (ec) no 765/2008) [REG, Art. 3(26)]
[21] Article 50(1) — appliesFrom — 20 October 2026 (2026-10-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 12]
[22] EC declaration of conformity — hasObligation — must contain the following particulars (must contain the following particulars) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[23] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) (eu type-examination (module b)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[24] instructions, safety information and Annex III information — hasObligation — be in a language which can be easily understood by users (be in a language which can be easily understood by users) [condition: as determined by the Member State concerned] [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[25] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: in any event] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[26] relevant economic operator — hasObligation — take appropriate and proportionate corrective action (take appropriate and proportionate corrective action) [condition: the market surveillance authorities find that the product within the scope of this Regulation does not comply with the requirements laid down in this Regulation] [REG, Art. 43(1)]
[27] safety components — listedIn — Annex II (annex ii) [REG, Art. 7(1)]
[28] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A (EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A) [condition: or alternatively, internet address or machine-readable code where that EU declaration of conformity can be accessed in the instructions for use] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[29] CE marking — hasObligation — must be followed by the identification number of the notified body (must be followed by the identification number of the notified body) [condition: Where the full quality assurance procedure referred to in Article 12(3)(c) and 12(4)(b) has been applied] [DIR, Annex III]
[30] essential health and safety requirements — definedAs — the mandatory provisions, set out in Annex III (the mandatory provisions, set out in annex iii) [REG, Art. 3(14)]
[31] manufacturers — hasObligation — draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 (draw up the eu declaration of conformity in accordance with article 21) [condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[32] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product (for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[33] essential requirement 1.1.2(a) — addressesRisk — putting persons at risk (putting persons at risk) [condition: when these operations are carried out under the conditions foreseen] [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.2]
[34] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply one of the following procedures (shall apply one of the following procedures) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), and provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[35] essential requirement 1.3.3 — requiresMeasure — Precautions (precautions) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.3]
[36] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — accompanied by the instructions for use (instructions for use and the information referred to in Article 10(7)) [condition: in a language which can be easily understood by users, as determined by the Member State in which the machinery or related product is to be made available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[37] essential requirement 1.5.5 — addressesRisk — risk of injury arising from contact (risk of injury arising from contact) [REG, Annex III, 1.5.5]
[38] essential requirement 1.1.3 materials and products — addressesRisk — endanger the health and safety of persons (endanger the health and safety of persons) [REG, Annex III, 1.1.3]
[39] Annex I, Part A, point 2 essential requirement — requiresMeasure — Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices (guards for removable mechanical transmission devices) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 2]
[40] safety components — listedIn — Annex V (annex v) [DIR, Art. 2]
[41] manufacturer — hasObligation — inform users of the residual risks (inform users of the residual risks) [condition: due to any shortcomings of the protective measures adopted] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[42] economic operator — hasObligation — shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken (shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken) [condition: the products within the scope of this Regulation concerned that the economic operator has made available on the market, throughout the Union] [REG, Art. 45(2)]
[43] relevant economic operator — hasObligation — take all appropriate measures (take all appropriate measures) [condition: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds] [REG, Art. 45(1)]
[44] EU declaration of incorporation — hasObligation — shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts (shall include a sentence declaring the conformity with such acts) [condition: Where partly completed machinery is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity] [REG, Art. 22(3)]
[45] digital EU declarations of incorporation — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[46] notified body — hasObligation — any request for information (any request for information) [REG, Art. 40(1)]
[47] essential requirement 1.3.8 — requiresMeasure — Guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: on the basis of the type of risk] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8]
[48] category of machinery or related product — listedIn — Annex I, Part A (annex i, part a) [condition: if, according to the assessment referred to in paragraph 4, and taking into account the available information, it presents a serious inherent potential risk, and one or more of the following conditions is fulfilled] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[49] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) (conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)) [condition: followed by EU type-examination (module B), under option (a)] [REG, Art. 25(2)]

response.text: {"kind":"unknown","value":null,"text":"The facts give no explicit correspondence for Article 12 of Directive 2006/42/EC. They only show that Article 12(3) and (4) procedures apply to Annex IV machinery (Directive), and that Article 25(2) and (3) procedures apply to Annex I Part A and Part B categories (Regulation). A stated correspondence exists only for Article 11 of the Directive, which is replaced by Chapter VI of the Regulation.","used":[0,9,10,11,15,34]}
